name: Challenger (STS 41-B)
about: Challenger (STS 41-B) (1984-011A), a crewed vehicle (OV-099), launched 1984 Feb  3. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1984 Feb  5), held fixed
GCAT names the site (KSC RW15); its coordinates are written from memory
